articles.headline: Zero to hero: Socceroos' Robertson scores stunning match-winner after own goal

keyEvents.text: Goal! Middlesbrough 1, Bristol City 0. Adilson Malanda (Middlesbrough) header from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Sebastian Berhalter with a cross following a corner.
Aidan Morris (Middlesbrough) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Middlesbrough 1, Bristol City 0.
Goal! Middlesbrough 2, Bristol City 0. David Strelec (Middlesbrough) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Amario Cozier-Duberry following a fast break.
Substitution, Middlesbrough. Myles Peart-Harris replaces Riley McGree.
Substitution, Bristol City. Scott Twine replaces Sam Greenwood.
Substitution, Bristol City. Gibson Yah replaces Brian De Keersmaecker.
Substitution, Bristol City. Dom Ballard replaces Lorent Tolaj.
Substitution, Middlesbrough. Sam Byram replaces Callum Brittain.
Substitution, Middlesbrough. Will Lankshear replaces David Strelec.
Substitution, Middlesbrough. Luke Ayling replaces Sebastian Berhalter.
